title: Symmetry of a sum over distinct indices
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $a:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\times\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\mathbb{R}$ be any function. Then $\sum_{i<n}\sum_{j<n,\,j\ne i}a(j,i)=\sum_{i<n}\sum_{j<n,\,j\ne i}a(i,j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is any real-valued function of two indices less than $n$
